To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Etx increases the ability of intestinal DC to prime antigen‐specific T cell responses.
Etx stimulates mucosal immune responses by increasing the ability of DC to prime T cell responses and by directing these DC into the T cell areas of MLN.

the oral adjuvanticity of Etx is associated with increased activation and antigen transport by lymph DC and that Etx‐activated lymph DC migrate to the T cell regions of MLN and stimulate stronger T cell responses.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding how dendritic cells (migratory and resident) are activated in the intestine to stimulate the development of immune responses.
the regulation of intestinal immunity.
how the body defends itself against infection.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Etx stimulates the activation, antigen uptake and localization of migrator DC, which results in stronger antigen‐specific immune responses in vivo.
the oral adjuvanticity of Etx in rats and mice is not due to increased numbers of DC migrating to the MLN.
the oral adjuvanticity of Etx is associated with changes in the migration, activation, and antigen‐transporting capacity of DC.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the adjuvant effect of Etx is due to the increased activation of DC and that this is due to the induction of CD25 expression on the CD172a‐high subset of lymph DC.
Etx increases the number of DC in the small intestine, increases the number of antigen containing DC, enhances their activation, and directs them to the T cell area of MLN.
Etx is an adjuvant because it alters the activation, localization and antigen transport properties of intestinal DC, and this results in a more effective antigen presentation to the immune system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
oral Etx does not increase the number of lymph DC, but it does affect the activation, antigen uptake and localization of these cells in MLN.
Etx does not increase migration of lymph DC but does affect the activation, antigen capture and localization of these cells.
Etx does not increase DC migration from intestine to MLN.
